protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed. The private-connection path hardening passes file-valued 802.1X certificates and keys to wpa_supplicant as blobs, but ca-path and phase2-ca-path are directories and remained raw user-selected paths. Without a ca-cert, an unprivileged owner of a private WPA-Enterprise profile can select the trust directory and authenticate a rogue server. The CVE.org record is PUBLISHED and the Red Hat CNA describes this as an incomplete fix for CVE-2025-9615; the GHSA is not withdrawn.
